recommendation_precision.definition: Appropriate / recommendations with a definite appropriateness judgment; uncertain and missing judgments excluded.

reference_control_recall.definition: Distinct covered / reference controls, restricted to completely judged cases with supplied reference annotations; abstained cases remain in recall.

critical_control_recall.definition: Distinct covered essential / essential references in the same completely judged cases.

unsupported_recommendation_rate.definition: Unsupported / recommendations with a definite unsupported judgment; unknowns excluded.

flaw_detection_recall.definition: Matched / expected finding codes in cases with supplied finding annotations.

flaw_detection_precision.definition: Matched / reported finding codes in those annotated cases.

execution_success.definition: Completed / completed-or-failed attempts; BLOCKED and NOT_RUN excluded and counted separately.

abstention_rate.definition: Cases with no recommendations and explicit full abstention / selected cases.

citation_identity_accuracy.definition: Correct predicted binary decisions / supplied definite reference decisions for this evidence layer.

statement_entailment_accuracy.definition: Correct predicted binary decisions / supplied definite reference decisions for this evidence layer.

context_compatibility_accuracy.definition: Correct predicted binary decisions / supplied definite reference decisions for this evidence layer.

binary_quadratic_score.definition: Mean squared error of supplied probability of appropriateness versus definite judgments, on the binary 0-to-1 convention. Lower is better; this alone is not calibration.

limitations: Development expectations concern review-question codes, not independently expert-validated control truth.
Public method papers motivate scenarios; they are not entailment receipts or annotations of the generated controls.
All cases are development cases. No held-out scientific evaluation is claimed.
Offline software development baseline; no hosted model or biological validation.
Findings are provisional review questions. Reference-label agreement is not diagnosis accuracy.
The reference ablation retains only explicit causal-support mismatch and missing-unit checks.
Annotations and reviewer names are supplied attestations, not authenticated independent ground truth.
Development fixture metrics do not establish scientific control quality or agent generalization.
Wilson intervals are descriptive binomial summaries; correlated cases, controls, or sources require a separate inferential design.
No absent, uncertain, or unassessed annotation was silently treated as a correct recommendation.
